result.summary:
I opened https://forms.155-138-198-12.sslip.io/ (an Airlock demo fixture site) and enumerated the four pages it links to, then visited and screenshotted each one:

1. Regional sales, Q3 2026 (Variant A) — https://forms.155-138-198-12.sslip.io/data/regional-sales : A synthetic-dataset page showing revenue and target by region (North 120/100, South 80/110, East 95/100, West 130/120, in thousands of dollars) as a table plus a CSV block, with a link to Variant B and a regional-sales.csv download.

2. Regional sales, Q3 2026 (Variant B / changed-inputs variant) — https://forms.155-138-198-12.sslip.io/data/regional-sales?variant=b : The same dataset page with deliberately changed numbers (North 90/120, South 115/100, East 105/100, West 125/120) to demonstrate that changing inputs changes results, linking back to Variant A.

3. Contact request — https://forms.155-138-198-12.sslip.io/f/contact-request : A controlled form (adapter airlock-forms-v1, form id contact-request) with Name, Email, Message and Approval-code fields for asking the fictional demo team to get in touch, which accepts a submission only with a one-use, person-approved code.

4. Order a sample — https://forms.155-138-198-12.sslip.io/f/order-sample : A controlled form (adapter airlock-forms-v1, form id order-sample) with SKU, Quantity, Delivery address and Approval-code fields for requesting a fictional product sample that is never shipped, likewise requiring a one-use approval code.

No form was submitted at any point. Note: early in the session a person briefly held the browser and it landed on https://forms.155-138-198-12.sslip.io/f/contact-request/submit, which displayed only "Submission refused: no valid approval for exactly these values — nothing was recorded"; that page is not linked from the homepage and no data was recorded on it. Screenshots were taken of the homepage and all four linked pages (artifacts art-905e7757c7bab89f3269, art-622c8a9a8e43ae44ba02, art-787204296234a77417ea, art-dc8cd3d126f53c843035, art-ab03bab65085dbed68e0).
